heading: State
lead: In this division, the term “State” means—

tree.text: a State, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, the Virgin Islands, and the Northern Mariana Islands; and
the Republic of the Marshall Islands, the Federated States of Micronesia, and the Republic of Palau.
